title: MRR SourceFamily
description: docs/spec/02_DOMAIN_MODEL.md section 2.10: represents evidence DEPENDENCE between sources, so that source COUNT is never mistaken for evidence INDEPENDENCE (MRR-FR-065). Invariant: family confidence is not used to silently delete sources — representation here is strictly ADDITIVE. A SourceFamily only ever references member SourceRecords (schemas/source-record.schema.json) by urn; it never embeds, mutates, or deletes them. Design decisions (task-packets/E3-T03.yaml asks that these be made and documented): (1) there is no separate 'family_id' field — the base object's own 'id' (baseObject#/properties/id, minted with URN entity 'source-family') already names this family, exactly like every other entity in this schema family (Claim.id, SourceRecord.id, ...) never duplicates its own identity under a second field name. (2) 'confidence' is a plain number in [0, 1] rather than an enum: it records the detecting method's own confidence that the relationship classification is correct — NOT a calibrated epistemic probability of anything, and NOT itself an independence weight (that translation belongs to the independence calculator, E3-T05; AGENTS.md's prohibited-shortcuts list: 'using an LLM confidence number as epistemic confidence'). (3) 'origin_ref' may be a urn (when the origin is itself a known SourceRecord), a free-text descriptor (when the origin is an external dataset/wire/press-release distributor never itself retrieved as a SourceRecord), or null (origin not yet known, e.g. relationship_type 'uncertain').

origin_ref.description: The origin source or dataset the members are believed to derive from (domain 2.10: "origin source or dataset"). A urn:mrr:source-record:... when the origin is itself a known SourceRecord in this corpus; a free-text descriptor otherwise; null when not yet known.

member_source_ids.description: Member SourceRecords (domain 2.10: "member sources"), referenced by urn only — never embedded, so a source belongs to a family without the family owning its content. At least one member is required: a family referencing zero sources represents nothing (the same non-degeneracy reasoning correction-event.schema.json's affected_objects already applies).

relationship_type.description: domain 2.10's exact relationship-type vocabulary. Out-of-vocabulary values are rejected — fails closed.

confidence.description: The detecting method's own confidence, in [0, 1], that this relationship_type classification is correct. See this schema's own top-level description for why this is not treated as a calibrated epistemic probability or an independence weight.

detecting_method.description: Free string (domain 2.10 gives no enumerated vocabulary for this field, confirmed by a full docs/spec/ search) — e.g. "manual editorial review", "shared DOI prefix heuristic", "text-similarity algorithm v2".
